document.abstract: The January 2023 Toronto Section meeting covered multicast network design and monitoring workflows within the broadcast and content distribution sectors of our industries. Multicast signal distribution is no doubt becoming more popular, and the concern often seems to be the apparent knowledge deficit, whether from someone with a broadcast background needing to know more about networking options or an IT professional needing to know more about broadcast signal requirements. Four presenters were invited to share their solutions for reliable multicast signal distribution.
